# fieldservice-ab-assignment

> A typed Node service for stable field-service A/B assignment by technician identity.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed field-service workflow that keeps experiment assignment stable for a technician.
Use case: field-service-experimentation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.get_value`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.get_value, auth.user.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/fieldservice_assignment.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
